self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: R1: after the wielder triggers a Swirl reaction, ATK +24% for 12s. Quoted values are R1; this entry also declares its R5 values in refinementStates, and the leaderboard's chosen weapon refinement selects between them (R2-R4 read R1).

R1: based on the number of party members whose Elemental Type differs from the wielder. 1 member: Charged Attack DMG +20%, Elemental Burst DMG +10%. 2+ members: Charged Attack DMG +48%, Elemental Burst DMG +24%. Quoted values are R1; this entry also declares its R5 values in refinementStates, and the leaderboard's chosen weapon refinement selects between them (R2-R4 read R1).

en.flavor: An ancient longbow crested with red feathers, a sacred relic of the Flower-Feather Clan that has been passed down from generation to generation.

refinements.1: For 12s after triggering a Swirl or Stellar Swirl reaction, ATK increases by <r>24%</r>. In addition, when 1/2 or more characters in the party are of a different Elemental Type from the equipping character, the DMG dealt by the equipping character's Charged Attacks is increased by <r>20%/48%</r>, and Elemental Burst DMG dealt is increased by <r>10%/24%</r>.
refinements.2: For 12s after triggering a Swirl or Stellar Swirl reaction, ATK increases by <r>30%</r>. In addition, when 1/2 or more characters in the party are of a different Elemental Type from the equipping character, the DMG dealt by the equipping character's Charged Attacks is increased by <r>25%/60%</r>, and Elemental Burst DMG dealt is increased by <r>12.5%/30%</r>.
refinements.3: For 12s after triggering a Swirl or Stellar Swirl reaction, ATK increases by <r>36%</r>. In addition, when 1/2 or more characters in the party are of a different Elemental Type from the equipping character, the DMG dealt by the equipping character's Charged Attacks is increased by <r>30%/72%</r>, and Elemental Burst DMG dealt is increased by <r>15%/36%</r>.
refinements.4: For 12s after triggering a Swirl or Stellar Swirl reaction, ATK increases by <r>42%</r>. In addition, when 1/2 or more characters in the party are of a different Elemental Type from the equipping character, the DMG dealt by the equipping character's Charged Attacks is increased by <r>35%/84%</r>, and Elemental Burst DMG dealt is increased by <r>17.5%/42%</r>.
refinements.5: For 12s after triggering a Swirl or Stellar Swirl reaction, ATK increases by <r>48%</r>. In addition, when 1/2 or more characters in the party are of a different Elemental Type from the equipping character, the DMG dealt by the equipping character's Charged Attacks is increased by <r>40%/96%</r>, and Elemental Burst DMG dealt is increased by <r>20%/48%</r>.

fr.flavor: Ancien arc long surmonté de plumes rouges, cette relique sacrée du Clan des fleurplumes a été transmise de génération en génération.
